review_candidates.description: 経験を活かし、SCM全体を俯瞰するキャリアへ。 Kinaxis Maestro × グローバル製造業。 大規模案件を担うソリューションアーキテクトへ 【募集背景】 弊社は、サプライチェーンマネジメント（SCM）を企業競争力の源泉と捉え、製造業を中心に調達・生産・物流・販売を一体で最適化するソリューションを提供しております。 市場変化が激しい現在、安定供給とコスト最適化を両立させるためには、従来の枠を超えた改善と、デジタル技術を活用した新しい仕組みづくりが不可欠です。 弊社のSCMソリューションのラインナップのひとつにKinaxis Maestro(カナダ製）があります このソリューションを自動車、半導体製造装置、ハイテクといった組立型製造業へ提供し、お客様とともに、需要予測の高度化、在庫の適正化、調達リスクの分散など、 サプライチェーン全体を俯瞰した改革を推進しています。 日本を代表するグローバル企業を中心から新進の成長企業まで幅広く導入いただき、近年では半導体関連のお客様が増加しています。 そこでお客様の期待に応えるべく、ソリューションアーキテクトおよびソリューションコンサルタントを増員することに致しました。 キャリア入社の方には、これまでの経験を活かしながら、より広い視点でサプライチェーンマネジメント全体に関わっていただける環境があります。 私たちとともに、強くしなやかなサプライチェーンをつくり上げ、製造業の成長を支える中核メンバーとして活躍していただける方をお待ちしています。 SCMコントロールタワーソリューション Kinaxis Maestro™(旧称:RapidResponse®) ｜製品・サービス｜JFEシステムズ 【このポジションの魅力】 ・自らの提案がSCM変革に直結する、やりがいの大きいポジションです。 ・お客様の大半がグローバル企業であり、グローバル規模のサプライチェーンにたずさわることができます。 ・当社における新しい事業領域やソリューションの開拓、ビジネスモデルの企画検討にも関わることができます。 【組織】 配属組織は、デジタル製造事業本部第２開発部となります。 SCMソリューションの販売・導入をしている部署となります。 第2開発部メンバー構成は以下の通りです（2026年3月1日時点）。 ・組織マネージャ1名 ・DM(デリバリーマネージャ）5名 ・SA（ソリューションアーキテクト）８名 ・SC(ソリューションコンサルタント）28名 【勤務地】本社（浜松町） 【業務内容】 ・「Kinaxis Maestro」導入におけるモデル設計（設計責任者）、導入支援業務のリーディング ・SCMソリューションのプリセールス ・新しいソリューションの企画検討 ※大手自動車、半導体関連、電子部品メーカー向けへの導入支援が主となります。 ※プロジェクト規模は5名程度、期間は1年程度です。 ※担当業務により異なりますが、1週間に2、３日程度在宅勤務の方が多いです。 【キャリアパス】 ・入社後：「Kinaxis Maestro」の技術習得後、ソリューションコンサルタントとして導入支援業務を担当 ・3年後：ソリューションアーキテクトとして中小規模案件のソリューション提案、モデル設計を担当 ・最終的な役割：大規模グルーバル案件のソリューションアーキテクトを担当 【必須要件】 ・業務パッケージソフト（SCM以外もOK)におけるモデル設計経験がある方（３年以上） 【歓迎要件】 ・SCM（Kinaxis Maestro以外もOK）の導入経験がある方 ・新事業（SCM関連領域）の企画に興味のある方

review_candidates.title: Vice President Operations
review_candidates.description: Nexus Family Healing : Vice President of Operations Job Location : Plymouth, Minnesota (Hybrid; frequent travel required) Compensation : $190,000–$205,000 annually Motus Recruiting and Staffing is proud to partner with Nexus Family Healing in its search for its next Vice President of Operations. ABOUT NEXUS FAMILY HEALING For more than 50 years, Nexus Family Healing has helped children, adolescents, adults, and families find hope and healing. What began in 1972 as a single program in Minnetonka, Minnesota, has grown into a nationally recognized network serving communities across five states. As a leader in youth and family mental and behavioral health, Nexus provides services designed to meet individuals and families where they are, including residential treatment, community-based mental health, crisis and stabilization services, foster care and adoption, and other programs supporting children and families. Nexus embraces diversity, promotes equity, and fosters inclusion. As a national mental health organization serving diverse communities, Nexus strives to build a workforce that reflects and supports the people it serves. OVERVIEW OF THE VICE PRESIDENT OF OPERATIONS ROLE Direct Reports: Executive Directors and other designated agency leaders The Vice President of Operations – Community-Based Services provides strategic leadership and operational oversight across assigned Nexus agencies and programs. Working closely with Executive Directors and senior leadership, the VP will ensure strong operational, financial, clinical, quality, and service-delivery outcomes. This leader will supervise, coach, and develop Executive Directors while maintaining a strong understanding of agency programs, operations, staffing, financial performance, and key performance measures. The VP will translate enterprise strategy into actionable plans, strengthen operations, improve performance, support organizational growth, manage risk, and ensure services remain aligned with Nexus Family Healing’s mission and standards. The successful candidate will bring significant leadership experience in mental health, behavioral health, healthcare, or human services, including direct experience with both community-based and youth residential programs. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES Executive Leadership & Operational Excellence Provide leadership and oversight to Executive Directors and agency leadership teams across multiple service lines. Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performing organizational culture aligned with Nexus values. Drive accountability for operational, financial, strategic, and service delivery outcomes. Develop leadership talent through coaching, mentorship, and performance management. Strategic Planning & Business Performance Partner with organizational leaders to develop and execute strategic plans that advance Nexus's mission and goals. Oversee financial performance, including budget development, revenue growth, operational efficiency, and long-term sustainability. Support organizational growth initiatives, new program development, service expansion, and strategic partnerships. Collaborate across departments to implement system-wide initiatives and best practices. Risk Management, Compliance & Quality Ensure agencies meet licensing, accreditation, regulatory, contractual, and grant requirements. Monitor performance through data-driven reporting and continuous improvement practices focused on quality, safety, employee experience, and client outcomes. Partner with agency leaders to identify, mitigate, and manage operational and organizational risks. Community Engagement & Philanthropic Stewardship Represent Nexus within communities, building and strengthening key stakeholder relationships and partnerships. Support Executive Directors in board engagement, fundraising efforts, community advocacy, and organizational visibility. Promote a culture of philanthropy, collaboration, and community impact across the organization. Organizational Leadership Lead and participate in enterprise-wide initiatives, special projects, and cross-functional efforts that support organizational success. Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to Executive Directors, senior leadership, and Home Office teams. QUALIFICATIONS Minimum Qualifications Master’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or another clinical/human-services-related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience working in organizations serving children, adolescents, and families. Minimum of eight years of experience in mental health, behavioral health, or healthcare. Minimum of five years in upper-management positions with demonstrated expertise in operational, program, and clinical management. Minimum of three years of direct experience with community-based programs. Minimum of three years of direct experience with youth residential programs. Demonstrated experience supervising, coaching, and developing senior leaders and multidisciplinary teams. Strong financial and operational management experience. Knowledge of licensing, regulatory, accreditation, contractual, quality, and compliance requirements. Ability to travel frequently. Valid driver’s license and ability to meet applicable state and Nexus driving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Applicable licensure in a human-services or clinical field. Business or leadership development certification. 10+ years of operational leadership experience in a mental health-related field. Experience leading multiple programs, facilities, locations, or service lines. Experience supervising Executive Directors or comparable senior leaders. Experience with organizational growth, program development, service expansion, or operational transformation. Experience supporting Boards, fundraising, community partnerships, or external stakeholders. ICARE Values & Behavioral Competencies: Innovation: Leading the way and implementing creative, cutting-edge ideas and approaches. Compassion: Listening, honoring differences, and showing respect, kindness, empathy care, and concern. Agility: Exhibiting flexibility and adapting quickly. Responsiveness: Being quick, positive, and accurate. Excellence: Demonstrating quality results that surpass ordinary standards. BENEFITS Benefits include five weeks of PTO in the first year, multiple health insurance options, no-cost life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, 401(k) matching, Talkspace Therapy, Hinge Health, Carrot Fertility, tuition assistance, training opportunities, and career advancement opportunities. ABOUT MOTUS RECRUITING AND STAFFING, INC. Founded in 2006, Motus Recruiting and Staffing is an award-winning recruiting and staffing firm specializing in executive search, professional services, and technology solutions. Motus is committed to increasing representation in leadership and helping organizations advance equity through intentional, inclusive, and human-centered recruitment practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Responsibilities Job Description Sales Strategy And Market Expansion Execute Visa’s Government Solutions sales strategy across selected Western and Central Africa markets, identifying priority clients, solution opportunities, and growth areas that support revenue, market expansion, and broader strategic objectives. Originate opportunities that help governments use digital payments, wallets, and payments data to strengthen service delivery, improve decision-making, and drive better outcomes across sectors such as social protection, agriculture, health, education, mobility, and public finance. Support strategic accounts, priority pursuits, and multi-stakeholder initiatives across the region, with travel as required based on client, partner, and business needs. Pipeline, Account Planning, And Opportunity Execution Build, manage, and advance a strong pipeline of public sector opportunities, developing account plans, sales strategies, business cases, and value propositions that position Visa competitively and connect commercial outcomes to measurable public sector impact. Lead or support RFP development, proposal coordination, and opportunity execution, ensuring disciplined pipeline management, high-quality submissions, and timely progression of strategic pursuits. Government And Public Sector Stakeholder Engagement Establish and strengthen relationships with key public sector stakeholders, including national, provincial, and local government agencies, ministries, regulators, and public institutions, to understand priorities, shape opportunities, and navigate procurement processes through bid and award stages. Representing Visa with professionalism and sound judgment, proactively resolving issues that may affect sales performance, stakeholder engagement, or solution delivery, while leading through influence in a matrix environment. Ecosystem Partner Development And Commercial Enablement Identify and engage ecosystem partners, including issuers, processors, program managers, fintech's, and technology providers, to strengthen Visa’s government solutions offering and support scalable, locally relevant payment programs. Support partners in developing and executing clear commercial strategies and action plans to achieve their agreed business commitments, including revenue targets, program milestones, and market activation objectives. Work closely with issuers, processors, fintech's, program managers, and other ecosystem partners to identify growth opportunities, remove execution barriers, and align activities with Visa Government Solutions’ priorities. Monitor partner progress, provide guidance on corrective actions where needed, and ensure partner initiatives contribute to measurable commercial outcomes and successful public sector program delivery. Internal Collaboration And Cross-Functional Alignment Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across VGS Centre of Excellence, VGS CEMEA Commercialization and Go-to-Market, Visa Government Affairs, Product, Solutions, Marketing, Communications, Client Services, and regional and country teams to align on outreach, opportunity development, market education, and proposition roadmaps. Market Intelligence And Solution Positioning Provide market insight and client feedback to help shape Visa’s solutions and support the positioning of Visa’s capabilities in payments intelligence, digital acceptance, wallet-enabled service delivery, and public sector transformation. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD Preferred Qualifications 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Public Policy, Public Administration, Technology, or a related field required; MBA or relevant Masters’ degree an advantage. 5 - 8 years of relevant experience in business development, enterprise sales, account management, or government solutions sales, ideally in payments, financial services, fintech, technology, or the public sector. Experience selling to West and Central Africa public sector institutions an advantage. Strong understanding of public sector institutions, procurement, and government decision-making, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders and originate opportunities in complex sales environments. Strong consultative sales, relationship management, and business case development skills, with the ability to clearly articulate the value of digital payments for both commercial and public sector outcomes. Strong financial and commercial acumen, with excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and spoken English required; French is an advantage. Experience with government payment programs, public finance digitization, digital disbursements, wallets, social payments, procurement payments, or related infrastructure would be an advantage, as would familiarity with how payments data, transaction insights, and digital platforms can improve decision-making and service delivery. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
